topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server OS Command Injection Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Collabora Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server when used within the NextCloud platform contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution when the CODE server isn't running.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Zammad GmbH Zammad Session Fixation Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains a session fixation vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution as the zammad user. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102490.

topMovers.product: Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock
topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock Use-After-Free Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Zammad GmbH Zammad Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that can allow the local zammad user to escalate privileges to root. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102489.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Vite Vitejs Improper Access Control Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Vite Vitejs contains an improper access control vulnerability that exposes content of non-allowed files using ?inline&import or ?raw?import. Only apps explicitly exposing the Vite dev server to the network (using --host or server.host config option) are affected.
N-able N-Central contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability that could lead to command execution.

topMovers.product: Privileged Remote Access (PRA) and Remote Support (RS)
topMovers.vulnerabilityName: BeyondTrust Privileged Remote Access (PRA) and Remote Support (RS) OS Command Injection Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: BeyondTrust Privileged Remote Access (PRA) and Remote Support (RS) contain an OS command injection vulnerability that can be exploited by an attacker with existing administrative privileges to upload a malicious file. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can allow a remote attacker to execute underlying operating system commands within the context of the site user.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Google Chromium contains a type confusion vulnerability in the V8 JavaScript and WebAssembly engine.

PaperCut NG/MF contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that allows an attacker to manipulate system configuration parameters and execute arbitrary Java bytecode residing on the application classpath under the security context of the PaperCut server process. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-81578.
Commvault Web Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows a remote, authenticated attacker to create and execute webshells.

highestSignals.shortDescription: PHP contains an out-of-memory corruption vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.
PHP contains a stale internal request-state vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Google Brotli Unchecked Return Value Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Google Brotli contains an unchecked return value vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Commerce and Magento Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Adobe Commerce and Magento contain an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition Integer Overflow or Wraparound Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contain a integer overflow or wraparound vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server via a specially crafted regular expression in a CI/CD configuration, due to insufficient regular expression validation.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Missing Initialization of a Variable Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains a missing initialization of a variable vulnerability that could allow for unintended modification of page-cache-backed data via failure to preserve the shared-fragment marker during socket buffer coalescing, causing ESP input processing to decrypt shared fragments in place. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 to implant PHP webshells and run commands as root.

highestSignals.product: Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software
highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software Unchecked Return Value to NULL Pointer Dereference Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software contains an unchecked return value to NULL pointer dereference vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause the device to reload unexpectedly, resulting in a denial of service (DoS) condition.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that could allow a local authenticated attacker to escalate their privileges. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-118527.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Broadcom VMWare ESX Insufficient Logging Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Broadcom VMWare ESX contains an insufficient logging vulnerability that could allow a malicious actor with admin access to perform certain operations without being logged.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure Generation of Predictable Numbers or Identifiers Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a generation of predictable numbers or identifiers vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to upload files with attacker-controlled content to a known location on disk. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-111357.

observations: CISA added 10 actively exploited vulnerabilities during the last 7 days.
Other is the most represented technology category among this week's new KEVs (4).

CVE-2026-110447 is the largest 7-day rank riser, up 638 positions.
executiveSummary: CISA added 10 actively exploited vulnerabilities during the last 7 days. Other is the most represented technology category among this week's new KEVs (4). PHP Group has the most new KEV entries this week (2). CVE-2026-110447 is the largest 7-day rank riser, up 638 positions.
